name: Two-stage launch ascent
description: Deterministic planar ascent of an exploratory two-stage launcher to a target orbit: pitch programme and gravity turn, max-Q throttling, MECO and separation, then the booster and the upper stage integrated as separate entities (ballistic booster to impact, upper stage under explicit radial guidance to SECO and a coast). Requirements and invariants per entity and for the mission, judged on the true state; records vv-run.v2.

model_validity: Exploratory planar 3-DOF point-mass model; the vehicles are not real vehicles and nothing is validated against flight data. Spherical non-rotating Earth with inverse-square gravity, isothermal exponential atmosphere, constant drag coefficient, no winds, no attitude dynamics, no structural loads, no engine transients, no boostback or landing burn of the booster.
